gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-tc: Noto Sans TC keeps its curves open and its letters approachable, a sans with tall, generous counters. And Quilon sits above it with a gentle swell and thin in each stroke, giving the page a commanding editorial voice.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Commanding is how Quilon looks, its strokes swelling and thinning until the thin ones are about half the thick. Noto Sans Telugu does the opposite job, a plain sans with a high midline and counters that stay linked to the outside.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-thaana: Quilon's strokes move through a middling swing from thick to thin, which gives its display letters an editorial, assured stance. Noto Sans Thaana reads smoothly below, with wide channels into each counter.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-thai: Plump and friendly lowercase below, a poised editorial display above. Noto Sans Thai swells its letters like inflated glass beads, while Quilon keeps moderate contrast, neither stark nor flat, so each line has its own role.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-thai-looped: Noto Sans Thai Looped is a clean sans whose tall bodies make the lowercase look bold, with spacious gaps at curve ends. Quilon leads with display strength, though, and its thinnest points still carry real weight.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Rounded, open and quietly inflated. Noto Sans Tifinagh fills each line with generous lowercase bowls, so a long stretch beneath Quilon's modest stroke modulation would feel smooth and unhurried.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: Noto Sans Tirhuta is a contemporary sans-serif with terminals cut back to leave a big gap and a dominant x-height. Quilon's mild thick-thin shifts smooth the pace of a long read.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-ugaritic: Quilon brings editorial weight with strokes that vary only mildly. Noto Sans Ugaritic then follows with very little gap between x-height and cap height, its open mouths like a chalk arc left unjoined.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-vai: Noto Sans Vai makes words read as solid blocks, not skylines. Its generous space between curve ends and stems plus Quilon's calm gradient of weight along each rounded stroke make the pair feel modern and unhurried.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-vithkuqi: Crisp, open and quietly modern. Noto Sans Vithkuqi keeps a, c, e and s open at the throat with a minimal cap-to-lowercase step, while Quilon's soft cadence of fuller stems and slimmer links gives the pair its edge.
